summary: Validated new caixa (open/movement/close), PDV split payments, stock + recipe ingredient deduction, and dashboard summary. Backend: 9/10 pytest passed (only pre-existing public-preview CORS proxy issue). Frontend E2E: login → open caixa (idempotent) → add to cart → split payment (Dinheiro 1 + Dinheiro 17 for R$18) → sangria R$5 → suprimento R$10 → fullscreen toggle (pos-full class applied/removed) → close caixa with difference R$0 → back to open panel → overview cards + panels render. Direct GET /api/dashboard/summary returned day_total=72.50, day_sales_count=4, low_stock/recent_sales populated correctly.

critical.issue: Cloudflare proxy still returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * without Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true (pre-existing infra issue from iteration 5).

issues: When navigating from PDV back to Visão geral, the sidebar visually still highlights 'PDV' as active in the screenshot even though the overview page is rendered. Cosmetic only (page state IS updated because breadcrumb/content matches); likely a hover/focus artifact — worth double-checking the active-class rendering.

action_items: (Infra) Configure public preview proxy/Cloudflare to echo the explicit frontend origin and include Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true — application-level FastAPI CORS is already correct.
(Nit) Overview shows R$ 0,00 briefly before /api/dashboard/summary resolves because data starts null; consider a small skeleton/loading state to avoid the flash of zero values.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/sales deducts stock even when a session is not open (uses the incoming items regardless of register state). This is fine for now but note that sales missing register_id are excluded from register summaries — expected.

dashboard_summary computes day_expenses by scanning ALL sessions (open and closed) and filtering movements by today's created_at. OK but could be simplified by matching only today's session; low priority.
CrudModule.js is a very long single-line JSX file (>100 lines each concatenated) — hard to review/maintain. Consider splitting components onto multiple lines for readability.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create isolated TEST_ users via /api/auth/register; UI test used seeded caixa.pdv@padaria.com. No seed data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covers: register open/movement/close (incl. duplicate 409, invalid type 422), split-payment validation (sum tolerance 0.05), stock deduction on product and proportional recipe ingredient deduction (quantity * sold / yield_quantity), dashboard summary (day_total/month_total/day_profit/day_expenses/recent_sales/low_stock). Frontend Playwright covers login, register gate + open, add to cart, split payment confirm (message + register-sales-summary update), sangria, suprimento, fullscreen toggle (pos-full class), close register with difference 0, and Overview navigation. The seeded user caixa.pdv@padaria.com will often already have an open register from prior tests — the PDV panel handles both cases. Preview CORS remains a proxy-level known issue.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new failing feature. The CORS anomaly is proxy-level (Cloudflare rewriting), not FastAPI (which is correctly configured with credentials + explicit origin).
